findings.statement: Filesystem alias detection executes configured Git clean filters, violating the static-only boundary.
assumptions_used: SPEC AC1-AC3 applies to catalog scan/query behavior; no research execution is authorized.
reproduction: Create a temporary Git repository with a committed model.py. Declare it in both git_sources and filesystem_sources.
Write .gitattributes containing model.py filter=catalog_fixture and configure git filter.catalog_fixture.clean to touch an external temporary marker and then cat. Modify model.py without staging it.
Run Scanner(connection, scope).run(). Observed STATIC_FILTER_EXECUTED True: the marker appears even though Scanner never explicitly imports model.py.
findings.recommended_change: Remove git diff-based cleanliness detection; compare inert raw bytes with catalogued Git blobs, or otherwise ensure clean filters and fsmonitor cannot execute. Add a marker-based regression fixture.

findings.statement: Path-sensitive extraction cache omits conjecture/experiments context and can misclassify identical source bytes depending on scan order.
assumptions_used: SPEC AC1-AC3 applies to catalog scan/query behavior; no research execution is authorized.
reproduction:
Use YAML bytes: entries:
- id: P1
  title: Example
  status: ACTIVE
Create Scanner on an empty DB, register source x, call material(x,a.yaml,bytes), then material(x,conjectures.yaml,bytes).
Observed catalog rows for both paths have kind=evidence. Direct structured extraction of conjectures.yaml requires proposition because its context contains conjecture.
findings.recommended_change: Use one shared extraction-context function in both parsing and cache identity; include every path-sensitive classifier input. Add order-independent fixtures for conjectures and experiments.

findings.statement: Incremental scans silently retain oversized metadata-only results when extraction limits increase.
assumptions_used: SPEC AC1-AC3 applies to catalog scan/query behavior; no research execution is authorized.
reproduction: Commit a.py containing def visible(): followed by return 123456789. Scan it with text_limit_bytes=4.
Increase the same declared scope to text_limit_bytes=1000 and run Scanner against the same DB.
Observed parsed_new=0, a.py remains oversized_text, and code query returns 0 records.
findings.recommended_change: Either reject changes to extraction-affecting scope with an actionable new-DB instruction, or invalidate affected metadata/archive caches and dependent snapshots. Do not advertise a new scope while retaining incompatible old extraction results.

findings.statement: The --source filter is silently ignored for --kind source.
assumptions_used: SPEC AC1-AC3 applies to catalog scan/query behavior; no research execution is authorized.
reproduction: Scan one Git source r and one filesystem source fs.
Observed result includes both r and fs because sources uses id rather than source_id.
findings.recommended_change: Apply the source filter to sources.id for kind=source; add a two-source query regression.

findings.statement: --not-in-ref all reaches an absent temporary table and raises an uncaught SQLite OperationalError.
assumptions_used: SPEC AC1-AC3 applies to catalog scan/query behavior; no research execution is authorized.
reproduction: On a populated catalog connection call query(connection, ref="all", not_in_ref="all").
Observed OperationalError: no such table: query_excluded. The same defect applies to working exclusion before any earlier exclusion initializes the table.
findings.recommended_change: Reject unsupported exclusion pseudo-refs with ValueError, or implement their selected sets explicitly before generating SQL.
